_twin_stream_comment: Twin's head-cam feed, registered as a second MAIN-VIEW source (viewmodeButton toggles VideoFeed between this and the avatar stream above) -- not a PiP entry. Ports match config/pipeline_config_twin_overlay_local.yaml's head_cam override (avatar's 5004/5005/5007 + 900) in the simulator repo. Set "enabled": false when the twin process isn't running -- the source is then never registered (no socket, no decode thread, no reconnect timer) and the main view is avatar-only. Absent "enabled" defaults to true.
